articles.title: Pudgy Penguins winds down Pudgy Party mobile game
articles.snippet: Pudgy Penguins will halt development of Pudgy Party and focus on Pudgy World, as another Web3 gaming project shuts down after failing to find a sustainable business model.

articles.title: Pudgy Penguins NFT Game 'Pudgy Party' Shuts Down Less Than a Year After Launch
articles.snippet: Pudgy Party, a mobile battle royale game, has closed up shop as the Pudgy Penguins team shifts its focus to its Pudgy World experience.
